title: GQ-dual every-fixed-original-line-map direct D6 conditional expectation lower
statement: By genuine W(3,s) original point-line incidence duality, for every s=2^h>=8 and every fixed complete globally injected ORIGINAL line map g, one uniformly random COMPLETE globally injected ORIGINAL point map f satisfies E_f[D6(f,g)|g]>=s^6/8. Therefore min_g max_f S_s(f,g)>=s^6/8. This is the quantified dual of the fixed-f theorem and does not imply min_(f,g) S_s(f,g)>=c s^6.

quantifiers.domain: any fixed complete original line globally injected unordered physical-pair map
one independently uniformly sampled COMPLETE globally injected original point physical-pair map, shared across ALL original Q

external_dependencies: True original symplectic generalized quadrangle W(3,s) is self-dual under point-line incidence duality; same minimal physical alphabet and D6 positional classifier.
limitations: Symmetry swaps fixed/averaged typed source maps but does not remove the expectation quantifier.
There is no deterministic all-f,g lower bound or ROOT_BRANCHES proof.
This conditional D6 bound is different from AA4-N's auxiliary B/A charge expectation.
falsification_boundary: Preserve point-line duality on actual original W(3,s) factors and independently uniform complete global point map. Does not hold for arbitrary nondual source structures without proof.
